articles.title: 'Lượng tiêu thụ nước của trung tâm dữ liệu AI bị thổi phồng'
articles.summary: Sam Altman, CEO of OpenAI, stated that concerns regarding the massive water consumption of artificial intelligence data centers are exaggerated. He explained that cooling systems are continuously being optimized to minimize resource usage across facilities. The discussion highlights the ongoing industry efforts to balance rapid AI growth with environmental sustainability.

articles.title: Phát hiện manh mối về vật chất tối bí ẩn
articles.summary: Scientists using an underground detector in South Dakota have recorded an intriguing interaction that may be linked to elusive dark matter particles. The deep underground location helps filter out cosmic radiation and other interference to improve measurement precision. Further verification is underway to determine if this detection represents a major breakthrough in particle physics.

articles.title: CEO Tineco: Máy lau sàn khô ướt sẽ phổ biến như máy giặt
articles.summary: The CEO of Tineco stated that smart wet and dry floor washers are experiencing rapid growth in the consumer market. He predicted that these automated cleaning devices will soon become essential home appliances comparable to washing machines and refrigerators. Continued technological improvements in battery life and suction power are driving wider global adoption.

articles.title: Trung Quốc phát hiện mỏ chứa 200 tấn vàng
articles.summary: Geologists in China have discovered a massive deposit in Anhui province containing an estimated 200 tons of gold and one million tons of copper. The significant finding adds valuable reserves to the nation's critical mineral and precious metal supply. Detailed exploration work is continuing to plan sustainable extraction and processing strategies.

articles.title: Khu nghỉ dưỡng chỉ nhận đặt phòng bằng thư tay
articles.summary: El Elevador resort offers a unique retreat experience by ditching online booking systems, televisions, and wireless internet. Guests must send a handwritten letter to reserve their stay and immerse themselves in the unplugged environment. This deliberate hospitality approach encourages mindful relaxation and a break from modern digital distractions.

articles.title: Thụy Điển mời khách 'đi nhẹ, nói khẽ' đến ở miễn phí
articles.summary: Sweden is offering international travelers free stays in coastal cabins under the condition that they maintain strict silence during their visit. The initiative aims to promote peace, digital detox, and deep appreciation for the serene Nordic natural landscape. Visitors can enjoy peaceful views while unwinding in an environment designed for total mental recovery.

articles.title: Kinh nghiệm nhìn thời tiết săn mây ở miền Bắc
articles.summary: Successful cloud hunting in northern Vietnam requires travelers to understand specific meteorological conditions rather than just arriving in the right season. Key indicators such as high humidity, light wind, and temperature differences after light rain greatly increase the chance of seeing a sea of clouds. Travelers can maximize their scenic journeys by carefully monitoring these weather metrics before embarking on mountain treks.

articles.title: Dự án mật có thể giúp CXMT nắm công nghệ DRAM của Samsung
articles.summary: Reports indicate that Chinese memory maker CXMT has pursued a long-term strategy to acquire memory manufacturing talent and technical expertise. The efforts focus on narrowing the technological gap with leading semiconductor producers like Samsung in advanced DRAM production. This development reflects intensifying global competition in microchip engineering and advanced fabrication capability.

articles.title: Cyborg Roaches Can Stab You With Needles
articles.summary: Researchers at the University of Queensland have developed prototype cyborg cockroaches designed to assist victims trapped under disaster rubble. Equipped with tiny electrodes and a remote-controlled syringe mechanism, the insects can navigate tight spaces and deliver emergency medication. The hybrid bio-robotic system demonstrates high navigation reliability and could provide crucial immediate aid before human rescuers arrive.

articles.title: Enovis to acquire surgical tech provider eCential Robotics for $180M
articles.summary: Medical technology company Enovis has announced the acquisition of surgical robotics specialist eCential Robotics in a deal worth 180 million dollars. The acquisition is intended to accelerate the commercialization of robotic systems designed for knee and shoulder orthopedic surgeries. Integrating these robotic capabilities aims to improve surgical precision and patient recovery outcomes.

articles.title: Calling robotics startups: Apply now to be part of the 2026 Robotics Startup Radar
articles.summary: Emerging robotics companies are being invited to apply for inclusion in the 2026 Robotics Startup Radar showcase. The initiative gathers promising early-stage automation and robotics ventures to connect them with industry leaders and investors. Selected startups will gain substantial visibility and opportunities to scale their automation solutions worldwide.

articles.title: NVIDIA plans to acquire Hugging Face and keep AI development platform open
articles.summary: NVIDIA has announced plans to acquire popular AI repository and collaboration platform Hugging Face while preserving its open-source ecosystem. Hugging Face currently hosts over one million machine learning datasets and models used widely across global tech communities. The deal aims to combine high-performance computing infrastructure with accessible open-source AI development tools.

articles.title: Renewable Energy And Storage Solve Massive Grid Problem In US
articles.summary: Renewable energy generation combined with battery storage systems has successfully resolved long-standing grid reliability challenges in Texas. Virtual power plants and distributed energy resources stabilized the regional electric supply even during periods of intense summer heat. The milestone highlights how clean technology can fortify power infrastructure against severe climatic conditions.

articles.title: A longer exhale may push your brain toward bolder decisions
articles.summary: New scientific research shows that slow breathing with an extended exhalation phase alters cardiac activity and increases the brain's reward sensitivity. This physiological shift encourages individuals to make bolder choices by shifting their risk evaluation process. The findings demonstrate that simple breathwork techniques can exert a direct influence on cognitive decision-making and wellness.

articles.title: ADHD may have a surprising creative advantage
articles.summary: A recent cognitive study suggests that the attention patterns associated with ADHD can provide distinct advantages in creative problem-solving. Defocused attention enables individuals to form novel connections and explore diverse ideas beyond conventional boundaries. Engaging in structured creative activities can help harness these cognitive traits while supporting focus and executive control.
